title_zh: 把故事课开场改为先听故事再分享

scenario.label_zh: 把故事课开场改为先听故事再分享
scenario.goal_zh: 调整故事课的开场结构，先示范短故事再邀请学员自愿分享

context_zh: 两名成人教育教师讨论下一次故事课的开场。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: The opening talk is informative, but I am not sure it will engage people who have never told a story in public.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Would an entertaining story work better than ten minutes of instructions?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Yes. I want the emphasis to be on sharing an experience, not giving a perfect performance.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Then I will tell a short story about missing my bus. It has a clear beginning and a funny ending.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: Could you also emphasize that nobody has to share before they feel ready?

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Of course. After my story, I will invite volunteers rather than call on people.

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.text: That sounds right. Let us move the technical advice to the end.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Agreed. I will rewrite the opening around the story.

targets.sense_zh: 吸引并保持某人的兴趣
